title: Events and Around You wait on their own page order, so nothing jumps when the page lands

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-19 design list (30 items), item 6; 2026-10-20 audit

detail: The 2026-10-20 audit found two loading screens still in the wrong shape. Events waited with search inside the header, the toolbar above Around You and a two-column grid, after LIVE-1014 moved search into the toolbar below the feature and the grid went three across. Around You waited on the generic index skeleton (find row and photo grid), not the map card and dashboard the page draws. Events now waits on header, Around You, toolbar and the three-column grid. Around You waits on the kit head, the map card's own pending frame, the ticker strip and the dashboard.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const e=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/events/events-loading.tsx','utf8');const n=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/nearby/loading.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];const i=['ev-hero is-plain','<FqAroundYouFrame','ev-tb','ev-list ev-list3'].map(m=>e.indexOf(m));if(i.some(x=>x<0)||i.some((x,k)=>k&&x<i[k-1]))bad.push('Events wait is not header, Around You, toolbar, 3-column grid');if(!/lead=\{<NearbyMapCard pins=\{null\}/.test(n))bad.push('Around You wait has no map frame');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1042: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Events or Around You wait drifts from its page order. Behavior is loading-order.test.tsx.
